result:
Regression fixed. In `anthrouter/http_util.py`, the header name `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining` was missing an "s". It is now `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so the requests-remaining value is recorded again.

The two rate-limit window tests in `tests/test_handlers.py` and `test_admin_requests_reflects_a_dispatched_request` in `tests/test_admin.py` now pass. I re-ran only `tests/test_handlers.py` and `tests/test_admin.py` after the fix, not the full suite.

Three failures from the first full run are unrelated to the rate-limit window, so I left them alone:
- `tests/test_handlers.py::test_cached_tier_is_not_replayed_into_a_different_requested_tier` still fails.
- `tests/test_handlers.py::test_locked_baseline_scopes_the_tier_slot_by_the_lock` still fails.
- `tests/test_config.py::test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields` failed in the first run. I didn't re-run `tests/test_config.py` and didn't look into it.
